source_note: Researched from organiser pages and listings (Meetup, Luma, Devnovate, indiahackathons.com, HackathonRadar, HackIndia, Reskilll, insiderOne, dev.events, eChai, Atlassian Community, Devpost)..

events.title: Women in Tech Bengaluru: OutGeekWomen
events.why: Community of women engineers and leaders; strong for mentorship and peer support.

events.title: Hack With Bangalore 4.0
events.why: 8-hour build day inside Microsoft's office with ~14,700 registrants. Selection happens, so a strong GitHub helps.
events.note: Listed as student-focused on HackathonRadar; Devnovate lists all skill levels. Bring your own laptop.

events.title: UbuCon India 2026
events.why: Volunteer-run open-source crowd: maintainers, Linux users and Canonical folks. Easy place to start contributing.

events.title: Mastering Generative & Agentic AI Workshop
events.why: Two hands-on days: transformers, RAG with LangChain, LangGraph agents, deploying on Hugging Face. Certificate included.

events.title: Agentic AI in Practice: Building, Evaluating and Earning Trust
events.why: PMs and product leaders (~390 RSVPs). Best pick for understanding why teams build what they build.

events.title: Bengaluru Tech Summit 2026 (29th edition)
events.host: Govt. of Karnataka (Dept. of Electronics, IT, BT and S&T)
events.why: Asia's largest tech summit: 1,600+ exhibitors, ~1,000 startups. Walk the startup pavilion and ask founders for demos.
events.note: BIEC is far north-west of the city. Allow 60–90 minutes from ORR/Whitefield.

events.title: gRPConf India 2026
events.why: Small, deep backend crowd: engineers running gRPC in production and CNCF maintainers.

events.title: droidcon India 2026
events.why: 60 speakers including engineers from Google, Blinkit and BookMyShow. Ideal for mobile engineers.

events.title: Bengaluru Pitch Circuit 9
events.host: BHIVE Startup Labs × The Startup Tales
events.why: Founders pitch live to investors. Great for learning startup motives and business models.

events.title: Agent Builders Community Day Bengaluru
events.why: A hands-on working day on agentic automation, with UiPath's roadmap and real customer stories.

events.title: KSUG.AI India #12 meetup @ HPE
events.why: Hosted inside HPE. Kubernetes and AI-infra engineers; discount codes for CNCF certifications are usually shared.

events.title: LLMOps in Production: Observability, Evals & Guardrails
events.why: Practitioners shipping LLM apps share what breaks in production (230+ RSVPs).

events.title: Agentversity AI Hackathon: Build the Agentic Future
events.why: One-day agent build. Good for finding collaborators who are already building agents.

events.title: Beyond 9to5 Buildathon Bengaluru
events.why: Aimed at people with day jobs; 150–200 selected participants, so the room is small enough to meet everyone.

events.title: Build with Agora: Voice AI Hackathon
events.why: Company-run: Agora's developer relations team mentors teams on its real-time voice SDK.

events.title: WordCamp Bengaluru 2026
events.venue: Bangalore International Centre (Sat) · St Joseph's Boys' High School (Sun)
events.why: Saturday is Contributor Day, the easiest way to meet maintainers by working alongside them.
events.note: Some listings give different dates; confirm on the WordCamp site.

events.title: flutterCon India 2026
events.why: Flutter and Dart developers building cross-platform apps.

events.title: AI Tools that Earn: a hackathon by Apify
events.why: Build AI tools you can publish and charge for on Apify's store. Apify's own team runs it.

events.title: Civo Navigate India 2026
events.venue: Sheraton Grand Bengaluru Whitefield Hotel & Convention Center, Hoodi
events.why: Cloud company's own event: product previews and networking with cloud and platform leaders.

events.title: WeAreDevelopers Conference India 2026
events.why: 3,000+ developers and 100+ speakers from Stripe, Atlassian, Adobe, JPMorgan Chase, Booking and more.
events.note: Code INDIA15 at checkout is offered by the organiser. BIEC: allow extra travel time.

events.title: Next Generation Testing & AI Bangalore
events.why: QA and test leaders exploring AI-powered testing.

events.title: The Messy UX Conference 2026
events.why: Designers and researchers. Good for understanding product thinking from the user side.

events.title: Open Lakehouse & AI
events.why: Data engineers talking open table formats and AI. Breakfast from 9:30, talks from 10.

events.title: Great International AI Native Summit (GAINS)
events.why: Engineering-first AI summit: orchestration, evaluation, observability and governance of AI systems.

events.title: Bengaluru Pitch Circuit 10
events.host: BHIVE Startup Labs × The Startup Tales
events.why: Founders and investors in one room. Go a second time and you'll already know people.

events.title: AI Vibecoding Hackathon
events.why: Two-day build. Register early; it's one of the few already announced for 2027.

events.title: AI for Lawyers Hackathon
events.why: Registration closes Nov 11; build runs to Dec 1.

events.title: PayPal AI Hackathon
events.why: Company-run, large prize pool, open to developers in India. Submissions due Nov 12.

events.title: Code for a Billion: Bharat Agentic-AI Hackathon
events.why: Deploy and open-source your project by Nov 15. Solo or team; each participant gets free tokens on AgentFoundry.

events.title: UGREEN Hackathon 2026 on AI NAS
events.why: Company hackathon on its AI storage product. Register by Nov 16.

events.title: BuildyourOwnWebsite
events.why: Beginner-friendly website build with a workshop component.

events.title: Orbix: 48-Hour Global Open Innovation Hackathon
events.why: Global participants, so a good way to meet builders outside India.

events.title: Nexconn Build Challenge 2026
events.why: Build on Nexconn's real-time chat platform. Submit by Nov 22.

events.title: HackWithAditya
events.why: Hybrid national hackathon with a large prize pool.

events.title: AgentVerse '26 (supported by OpenAI)
events.why: Month-long virtual agent build, open worldwide.

events.title: SpectoV National Hackathon (SNH '26)
events.why: National online hackathon; register by Nov 30.
events.note: Registration closes Nov 30 (or when 250 seats fill); the hackathon runs Dec 1–6, individuals only.

events.title: Cortensor Hackathon #5
events.why: Long-running build window, so it fits around a full-time job.

events.title: Cosmo Hacks 2026
events.why: Short weekend online hackathon over the holidays.

events.title: Vidyutspanda: Hardware Hackathon
events.why: One of the few hardware-focused hackathons in the city.

events.title: Colossus 3.O
events.why: Finale in the sports complex; biggest prize among campus events.

events.title: Prompt to Product
events.why: AI-first build track inside Acharya's tech fest.

events.title: The Big Hack 2.0
events.why: Flagship hackathon at Acharya.

events.title: Bits2Wave
events.why: In-person finale at BMSITM.

events.title: The DevForge Hackathon
events.venue: Scaler School of Technology (new campus, Doddathoguru)
events.why: Scaler's own hackathon; sharp student coders.

events.title: AlgoSSTrike
events.why: Hybrid algorithmic challenge; online rounds then on campus.

events.title: StarForge: 24-Hour National Level Hackathon
events.why: Overnight national-level finale; teams from across India.

events.title: From Amsterdam to Bangalore: Atlassian Team '26 Europe Community Recap
events.venue: RBD Sarovar Portico, Outer Ring Road, Bengaluru 560037
events.why: You will meet engineering and IT folks who run Jira and Confluence at Bengaluru companies, and hear what Atlassian announced at Team '26 Europe and how local teams plan to use it.
events.note: Corporate employees only; valid company ID needed, no walk-ins, entry closes 11:00.

events.title: eChai Startup Demo Day: HSR Edition
events.venue: Urban Vault, 477, 18th Cross Rd, Sector 1, HSR Layout, Bengaluru 560102
events.why: Early-stage founders demo live products and take questions, so you see what is being built in HSR and can talk to the people building it.

events.title: eChai Startup Demo Day: Koramangala Edition
events.why: A small room of Koramangala founders showing their products on screen, which makes it easy to ask how they think and swap contacts afterwards.

events.title: #BuildHybridAI 2026 (Firebase AI Logic)
events.why: Google-run challenge to build apps that mix on-device and cloud AI with Firebase AI Logic, a good way to learn the stack Google is pushing to mobile and web developers.
events.note: Submissions close Nov 30, 14:00 PT (Dec 1, 03:30 IST).

events.title: Meta VR Start Developer Competition 2026
events.why: Meta's own competition for hands-first VR apps, useful for seeing where Meta is taking its headset platform and getting into its Start developer program.
events.note: Requires Meta Horizon Start program membership; some countries excluded, check the rules for India eligibility.

events.title: Capture The Flag
events.why: A campus CTF where you can meet student security enthusiasts and test your own skills.

events.title: DevFest 2026 by GDG Cloud Bengaluru
events.venue: Google Ananta, Rio Business Park, Mahadevapura
events.why: A full day at Google's Ananta campus with Google Cloud engineers, GDEs and hundreds of cloud and AI builders.
events.note: Tickets at konfhub.com/devfest-blr-2026. Separate from GDG Bangalore's DevFest on Dec 5.

events.title: DevFest Bengaluru 2026 (GDG Bangalore)
events.venue: Google Ananta, Rio Business Park, Mahadevapura
events.why: Bengaluru's flagship Google developer festival, where you meet Android, web, Flutter and Gemini builders alongside Googlers.
events.note: Tickets at konfhub.com/devfestblr26.

events.title: GDG Bangalore Flutter Meetup with Eric Seidel
events.why: An evening fireside chat with Flutter co-founder Eric Seidel, then dinner and networking with the city's Flutter community.
events.note: Registration via the form linked on the event page; described as exclusive.

events.title: From App to Agent: AI on Mobile
events.why: A half-day at Google with mobile developers building on-device and agentic AI features into their apps.

events.title: Rootconf 2026: Platforms for AI, and AI for Platforms
events.venue: TERI Auditorium, 4th Main Road, Domlur II Stage
events.why: SRE, platform and infra engineers share production case studies on serving models and running AI workloads, so it is ideal for meeting senior infra people.

events.title: Rootconf Workshop: Break a model, then fix it (quantization)
events.why: A hands-on session with platform and MLOps engineers on shrinking open models to fit your own hardware without breaking them.
events.note: 30 in-person seats; members only.

events.title: Chaos Engineering for Stateful Apps on Kubernetes (Rootconf)
events.venue: Aerospike India, Indiqube Amber, Embassy Golf Links Business Park
events.why: Two afternoons breaking stateful systems on Kubernetes alongside Aerospike engineers and working SREs.

events.title: The Fifth Elephant Winter Edition 2026
events.venue: TERI, 4th Main Road, Domlur II Stage
events.why: Hasgeek's data conference, where data scientists and analysts from Bengaluru product companies show how they turn data into decisions.
events.note: Members-only registration when checked.

events.title: Rust Bangalore: November 2026 Rustacean Meetup
events.why: A small, technical crowd of systems programmers, with talks on a Zig agent harness and the sans-IO pattern.

events.title: Women in Systems: The minds behind the machinery
events.venue: Microsoft, Prestige Business Park, ORR Bellandur
events.why: Lightning talks and a panel at Microsoft from engineers who build databases, inference systems and cloud infrastructure.

events.title: Open Possibilities Unlocked @HPE (Collabnix)
events.venue: Hewlett Packard Enterprise, Whitefield Main Rd, Mahadevapura
events.why: A DevOps and cloud-native morning at HPE's campus with Docker and Kubernetes practitioners.
events.note: Same day and venue as KSUG.AI #12 @ HPE; the two may be co-located.

events.title: BangPypers <> Pathfinder Community Meetup
events.venue: Automation Anywhere, 12th floor, Prestige Trade Tower, Palace Rd
events.why: Bengaluru's long-running Python user group meets at Automation Anywhere's office, a good mix of Python engineers and automation builders.

events.title: BangPypers Python Meetup (December)
events.why: The monthly Python meetup is a reliable place to meet working Python and data engineers from across the city.

events.title: BangPypers Python Meetup (January)
events.why: The monthly Python meetup is a reliable place to meet working Python and data engineers from across the city.

events.title: Bangalore JUG: Every Java Object Pays a Tax
events.venue: Godrej Capital, CRN Chambers, 2nd Floor, Kasturba Road
events.why: A deep JVM memory talk hosted at Godrej Capital, with the city's Java backend engineers in the room.

events.title: JAVAFEST 2026
events.why: Bangalore JUG's annual one-day conference draws JVM engineers and speakers from Bengaluru's product companies.

events.title: Product (Un)Conference '26
events.why: An invite-only gathering of 350+ founders and senior product, tech and design leaders focused on building AI products in India.
events.note: Venue shared with confirmed attendees.

events.title: Symphony: India's Voice AI Summit (with Buildathon finale)
events.why: YC-backed Bolna brings voice-AI founders, builders, investors and OpenAI and Plivo people into one room, with live buildathon finalist demos.
events.note: Buildathon submissions are closed; only finalists compete on the day.

events.title: Expert Talks: AI Model Upgrades & Agentic Commerce
events.venue: Equal Experts India office (details on event page)
events.why: Equal Experts engineers share how they handle model upgrades in production and build for agentic commerce.

events.title: ReactJS Bangalore Meetup #110
events.why: The city's biggest React meetup, hosted at Mercari India, is the easiest way to meet frontend engineers from product companies.
events.note: Confirm on the Meetup page before going.

events.title: Engineering at the Frontier: Leadership Dinner (Women In Product India)
events.why: A small dinner at Toast's Bengaluru office where you can talk properly with senior engineering and product leaders.
events.note: Likely approval-based.

events.title: Groww Next '26
events.why: Groww's own product day, with hands-on demos of its AI investing tools and a look at how one of India's biggest fintechs thinks about product.
events.note: 18+ only; photo ID required.

events.title: Small Business AI Builder Tour: Bangalore
events.venue: Hilton Bengaluru Embassy Manyata Business Park
events.why: A Bluehost-run day on using AI to build and run websites, useful for meeting indie builders and small-business founders.
events.note: Space limited.

events.title: AIBoomi Demo Room Bengaluru
events.why: Early-stage AI founders demo live products to the AIBoomi founder community, so you see new products and meet their builders.

events.title: Grace Hopper Celebration India 2027 (GHCI 27)
events.why: India's largest gathering of women technologists, with a big tech expo and engineers and recruiters from most major tech companies.
events.note: Day 1 is for under-25s; days 2–3 for mid and senior careers.

events.title: Diwali Festiverse: The Agent-to-Agent Hackathon (India Edition)
events.why: Agent builders demo in person to sponsors like Lyzr and Agent37, then stay for a Diwali networking evening.
events.note: Build online first; submissions due Nov 18, finalists named Nov 19.

events.title: DevRev Computer Conversations Buildathon
events.why: A short build run by DevRev's own team on its AI teammate Computer, a good way to meet the people behind one of Bengaluru's best-known AI startups.

events.title: DecodeX '26
events.venue: BMS Institute of Technology & Management, Yelahanka
events.why: Students qualify online, then build overnight on the BMSIT campus with IEEE mentors judging.
events.note: Online qualifier Nov 22; offline finale Nov 27–28.

events.title: Inceptrix 3.0
events.venue: JAIN (Deemed-to-be University), Faculty of Engineering & Technology
events.cost: Round 1 free; ₹1,000 per team for the finale
events.why: One of the bigger student prize pools in Bengaluru this season, with shortlisted teams pitching in person on JAIN's campus.
events.note: Round 1 closes Dec 24; on-ground finale Feb 19–20, 2027.

events.title: Kiroween 2026 (Kiro / AWS)
events.why: A large AWS-backed global build-off where founders and indie developers ship agent-built apps in public, with a Best Startup prize.
events.note: Closes Dec 4, 2:00 PM PT (Dec 5, 3:30 AM IST).

events.title: Codegeist 2026: Atlassian Forge Hackathon
events.why: Atlassian's flagship developer hackathon puts you among Marketplace app builders shipping real B2B tools on Jira and Confluence.
events.note: Confirm the exact deadline on Devpost (listings show Dec 22–23).

events.title: QNX Global Developer Hackathon 2026
events.why: A rare real-time OS hackathon that connects you with automotive and robotics engineers, a good fit for Bengaluru's embedded crowd.
events.note: Some countries are excluded; check India eligibility in the rules.

events.title: MLH Global Hack Week: Open Source Week
events.why: A week of live MLH workshops and challenges with student hackers worldwide, and an easy route to your first open-source contributions.

events.title: Lablab x AMD AI Academy Challenge
events.why: Gets you into the lablab.ai builder community and hands-on with AMD's GPU cloud, and it is still possible to join late.
events.note: Individuals only; needs an AMD Developer account.

events.title: DeveloperWeek 2027 Hackathon (online)
events.why: Sponsor challenges put your work in front of the API and dev-tool companies judging, such as Red Hat and Descope.
events.note: Submissions open soon; check the schedule for the exact cutoff.

events.title: VoyageHack 4.0
events.why: A travel-tech hackathon run by TBO.com that gets you noticed by the product and engineering teams of one of India's biggest B2B travel platforms.
events.note: Registration closes Nov 12.

events.title: 404 Hackathon
events.why: An Indian online hackathon with a sizeable prize pool that draws a large crowd of student and early-career builders.

events.title: AI Builder Hackathon (Product Space)
events.why: Run by a PM community startup, so you meet product managers and AI builders shipping product prototypes rather than just code.
events.note: Product Space runs sibling hackathons with the same Nov 14 deadline.

events.title: Anna AI OS Founding Builder Challenge 2026
events.why: Recruits founding builders for an AI OS startup, a direct route to an early-stage founding team.
events.note: Found only on listing sites; verify details before entering.

events.title: HackerRank Orchestrate Holiday Hackathon
events.why: A short AI-orchestration sprint from HackerRank where hiring-minded companies watch the leaderboard.
events.note: Deadline from a hackathon directory; confirm on the page.

events.title: emma Hackathon 2026: Multi-Cloud GPU Infra
events.why: An infra-focused hackathon that connects you with cloud and MLOps engineers building on multi-cloud GPU tooling.
events.note: Deadline from a hackathon directory; confirm on the page.

events.title: Arbiter Hacks V1
events.why: A global Devpost hackathon with a decent prize pool and a mixed student and indie-builder crowd.

events.title: NFL Big Data Bowl 2027 (Kaggle)
events.why: A prestigious analytics challenge judged by NFL and AWS data teams, with finalists presenting at the NFL Combine.
events.note: Confirm the deadline on Kaggle.

events.title: Microsoft Agent-a-Thon (December 2026)
events.why: A Microsoft-run build day for Copilot Studio agents aimed at working professionals, with three skill tiers.
